s.id AS sku_id, p.id AS spu_id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(customer_alias.alias, p.name) AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.sale_unit, s.mall_min_quantity AS min_order_qty, s.mall_quantity_step AS step_qty, s.product_type, (s.product_type = 'NON_STANDARD') AS non_standard, p.description, image.file_key AS primary_image_key, 'UNKNOWN' AS stock_status

FROM xsy_product_sku s JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id JOIN xsy_product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN xsy_customer_sku_alias customer_alias ON customer_alias.customer_id = #{customerId} AND customer_alias.sku_id = s.id AND customer_alias.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT i.file_key FROM xsy_product_image i WHERE i.spu_id = p.id AND i.deleted = FALSE AND i.is_primary = TRUE AND i.file_key LIKE 'public/%' ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 1) image ON TRUE

) UNION SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.name, parent.level, parent.sort_order FROM xsy_product_category parent JOIN visible_category child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.deleted = FALSE AND parent.status = 'ENABLED') SELECT id AS category_id, parent_id, name, level, sort_order FROM visible_category ORDER BY level, sort_order, id

WHERE
AND (p.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.spu_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(s.barcode, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.alias, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.mnemonic_code, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(customer_alias.alias, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND p.category_id IN (WITH RECURSIVE category_subtree AS(SELECT id FROM xsy_product_category WHERE id = #{query.categoryId} UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM xsy_product_category child JOIN category_subtree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id) SELECT id FROM category_subtree)
ORDER BY p.name, s.sort_order, s.id

SELECT s.id AS sku_id, image.file_key AS primary_image_key FROM xsy_product_sku s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT i.file_key FROM xsy_product_image i WHERE i.spu_id = s.spu_id AND i.deleted = FALSE AND i.is_primary = TRUE AND i.file_key LIKE 'public/%' ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 1) image ON TRUE WHERE s.id IN #{skuId}
